verdict.rationale: Gusto ships an official MCP server (mcp.api.gusto.com) letting LLMs like Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini access account data via natural language, which enables AI-driven interaction with the user's payroll data, but this is a connectivity/access layer rather than native, in-product AI-generated insights, anomaly detection, or proactive suggestions surfaced within the Gusto UI itself. missing for 10: evidence of first-party generative insights/recommendations embedded directly in the Gusto product UI, proactive suggestion features, or analytics dashboards powered by AI, plus independent hands-on validation of the MCP server's insight-generation quality.
